purpose: Screen whether increasing QNIM qubits improves validation classification when the readout uses only local ZZ correlations, while separating growing and fixed PCA input dimensions.

data.split_policy: Reuse the existing Q1.6 dataset and verify its train/validation hashes before execution; do not regenerate or repartition.
data.test_policy: Do not load, inspect, or evaluate the test split.

architecture.readout_features: 2 * n_qubits - 1: one marginal per qubit and one ZZ correlator for each adjacent pair

fixed_input_encoding.additional_qubits: Initialize in |0>; they receive no extra or fabricated input data and participate in the all-qubit EfficientSU2 ansatz and the marginal/adjacent-ZZ readout.
fixed_input_encoding.q4_policy: The fixed-input q4 point is identical to full-system q4 and is counted once, not trained twice.

training.budget_note: Keep shots at 512 to avoid changing measurement noise as another experimental variable; reduce iteration and batch budgets consistently across configurations.

analysis_limits: Treat the three initialization seeds as a descriptive screening pilot, not definitive statistical evidence.
The number of QNIM classical readout parameters still grows with the number of neighboring-readout features; report it alongside quantum parameter counts.
Do not select models or configurations using test results.

blockers: The general scaling runner currently uses a fixed matrix that does not include q4/q8 and hardcodes batch size 64.
The general scaling runner does not produce the paired PCA+SVM controls required by this protocol.
A dedicated runner or a backward-compatible extension is required before execution.
